messages.subject: New entropy values after major changes in tidy LPA
parts:
Hi everyone,
thank you so much for the update to 1.0.0! I think it is way easiert to get an overview over different models and number of profiles now!

I ran a profile analysis after the update again and encountered two problems and was hoping that you could help me with them.
1) It seems like values for entropy changed dramatically? So I was wandering whether you changed something in how entropy is estimated?
2) I now receive error messages which did not occur before: value out of range in 'gammafn'. What does this mean and is there a reason why it did not appear in the earlier versions of tidy LPA?

Thank you so much in advance!

messages.author: f235054bd9ff417a
messages.subject: Re: New entropy values after major changes in tidy LPA
parts:
Hi, thank you for your message. In short: there was an error in how the entropy statistic was calculated previously (when using {mclust}). Previously, it was calculated simply as the mean of the posterior probability that was highest (of all of the classes) for each case.

I think Caspar (copied here) may be able to weigh in on how it's calculated now. I'm responsible for the incorrect calculation and Caspar is responsible for correcting it!

I'm sorry for this issue, it was something we were very concerned about after noticing it and is something that motivated the new version.
Josh
